sentence: This project studies how differences in behavior among individuals and populations relate to movement, genetic connectivity and the environment.
This project studies how small RNA fragments made by rhizobia affect root nodules and nitrogen fixation in soybean.
This project studies how N-heterocyclic carbenes bind to gold nanoparticle surfaces compared with thiols.
This project supports a conference where researchers present and discuss permutation patterns and related areas of combinatorics.
This project uses chemical analysis to study the provenance of archaeological materials such as ceramics, chert and obsidian.
This project builds a CRISPR tool to find out how 3D genome organization affects gene expression in human neurons.
This project studies how fire is managed in protected areas of the cerrado and whether fire policies protect fire-dependent plants.
This project builds a miniaturized brain model that mimics brain folding to study how viral infection and brain shape affect each other.
This project develops ways to model how light interacts with materials that have both surfaces and volumes, at any scale.
This project develops extremely small particles made of magnetoelectric materials to detect and stimulate brain activity.
This project develops a technique that collects material from a nanoscale area of a sample and then analyzes it with chemical techniques.
This project studies how complex eigenvalues of non-Hermitian random matrices behave as the size of the matrices becomes large.
This project studies how topological insulators transport signals and how structured laser light can resist blurring caused by turbulence in the atmosphere.
This project builds algorithms that let robots recognize when they commit social norm violations and then repair the interaction.
This project supports a national platform where researchers grow and study 2D materials that are only a few atoms thick.
This project tests a coaching model to help community college faculty write research proposals in areas such as AI and quantum computing.
This project studies how thawing permafrost changes the flow of groundwater in the Arctic.
